The Petalfall is an axe obtained through completing a puzzle involving multiple "flowers" (one is only classified as a flower in the game), It has a swing power bonus towards Sakura Trees.

Details

The Petalfall is obtained by placing 4 special, glowing eukaryotes ("flowers") (three flowers and one mushroom) inside temples around the flowering meadows.

It has a passive ability to fell sakura trees with one swing.

Notes

The Petalfall Katana has a swing power of 0.7 making it only ever so slightly weaker than the Reinforced Axe with a 0.8 swing power, however, it's swing time being more than four times faster actually makes it significantly better than any other axe in the game excluding the emberbane because of it's ability to randomly strike a tree multiple times in one swing.

-- OUTDATED --

The Gravity Coil may be needed to obtain the axe.

You can go to Flowering meadows via Mike’s mines to avoid spending money on bombs.

Obtaining

Notes:
  • If all the flowers are owned by the same person, Petalfall will be in that player's ownership when it spawns. Otherwise, it will spawn with no owner and could potentially be stolen.
  • *When the first Flower in one of the Towers it starts a timer of 15-20 minutes before all temples reset.

Tutorial on how to get it linked below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VYqpjV9hEj4 - OUTDATED

And the whole tutorial written here

Gather the four flowers:

  • The Blizzard Bloom
  • The Tamed Mysterious Mushroom
  • The Corpse Flower
  • The Burning Blossom

With the flowers acquired, proceed to the next steps.

Go to the area around Flora Laura called the Flowering Meadows. Here you find 5 temples the 4 smaller ones are the ones you place the flowers. After placing a Flower the top of the temple should show a purplish beam.

  • Take the Blizzard Bloom to the beach area underneath the Flowering Meadows. You will find a waterfall, behind that there's a temple where you place the flower inside the bowl.
  • Next go up to the same level as Flora Laura. On a large rock which you can only climb by foot is the temple for the Tamed Mysterious Mushroom. Once again place the flower into the bowl and a purplish beam should emerge on top.
  • For the third flower you drive to the other side of the valley staying on the same level as Flora Laura. The green temple is for the Corpse Flower. Drive over the rock bridge and up to the temple and place the Corpse Flower into the bowl. Another purplish beam should appear.
  • The last flower is the Burning Blossom. I advise you to do this one last as driving down there will shake up your truck or force you to walk all the way around.
    • Jump WITH the flower to the same level as the temple, place the flower and reset to base (This is currently the least frustrating way some people found without extra tools).

After all flowers have been placed they should disappear and the sword should appear in the brown temple at the highest peak of the Flowering Meadows. Pick it up from the same kind of bowl as you placed the flowers.

Note: The temples have a cooldown which prevents the creation of multiple Petalfall Katanas in a short time. One may place as many flowers as they like in their respective temples, but only one set of flowers (one of each flower) will be consumed, and only one Petalfall will spawn - on an interval of fifteen minutes after the last Petalfall was spawned.

  • Take the Blizzard Bloom and go to the tower near Flora Laura. There will be visible steps. Once on top place the flower inside the tower.

  • Continue going downwards and through the water cave to exit.

Trivia

  • The Petalfall is currently the tallest axe in-game.
  • This axe is arguably the best one next to Emberbane in the game as of version 1.56.0 as it got heavily buffed. While it does not one hit trees, it compensates with having one of the fastest swing speeds.
  • Unlike other tools, the Petalfall does not have an animation for being held, instead being placed in the arm.
